name: Modern school (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Two-storey school, 36 x 16 m classroom block of brick with a white-rendered upper floor and ribbon windows, a cantilevered entrance canopy, plus a 20 x 16 m sports hall in ribbed metal cladding with clerestory glazing and a single-storey brick cafeteria behind. Inside: an entrance lobby, offices, a staff room, eleven classrooms off a central corridor on two floors, two stair cores and a lift, toilets on both floors; the gym with court markings, backboards, wall bars and bleachers; the dining hall with a servery hatch and a kitchen.
